on GatherImagesForPreview
	local tBlobID,tBlobData,tBlobURL,tBlobsList,xBlob
	repeat for each key xThisKey in currentQuizliQuestionsA 
		if currentQuizliQuestionsA [xThisKey]["QuestionData"]["ContentImage"] is not empty then
			put empty into tBlobID
			put empty into tBlobURL
			put empty into tBlobData
			put currentQuizliQuestionsA [xThisKey]["QuestionData"]["ContentImage"] into tBlobID
			put tBlobID & lf after tBlobsList
			
		end if
	end repeat 
	
	//appli_showLoading "Loading Images for Questions"
	delete last character of tBlobsList
	if tBlobsList = empty then
	else
		get cdb_sync(tBlobsList,"cdbBlobs","cloud",false,false)
	end if
	local tIndex
	repeat for each key xThisKey in currentQuizliQuestionsA 
		add 1 to tIndex
		//	appli_showLoading ("Loading Image " & tIndex)
		if currentQuizliQuestionsA [xThisKey]["QuestionData"]["ContentImage"] is not empty then
			put empty into tBlobID
			put empty into tBlobURL
			put empty into tBlobData
			put currentQuizliQuestionsA [xThisKey]["QuestionData"]["ContentImage"] into tBlobID
			put cdb_readBlob(tBlobID,"local","") into tBlobURL
			put url ("binfile:" & tBlobURL) into tBlobData
			put base64encode(tBlobData) into currentQuizliQuestionsA [xThisKey]["QuestionData"]["ContentImageBase64"]
		end if
	end repeat 
end GatherImagesForPreview
